name: Mention
description: Mention is a media-monitoring and social-listening platform for tracking brands, competitors, topics, and conversations across online sources. Its alerts organize monitoring queries, mentions, collaboration, and reporting for customer accounts.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-created Mention app access token and bind it to one exact account, then let agents inspect identity-redacted account status and bounded alert structure.

credentialRequirements.name: MENTION_ACCESS_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Mention access token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated app token for your own Mention account. Relay encrypts it and sends it only as a Bearer header to https://api.mention.net.

credentialRequirements.name: MENTION_ACCOUNT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Mention account ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Paste one exact account ID from Mention's official account API.

capabilities.label: Read account and alert structure
capabilities.description: Read bounded identity- and content-redacted account status and alert structure for one exact Mention account.

approvalRequired.label: Get Mention account status
approvalRequired.description: Read the exact bound account ID, language, and time zone without name, email, avatar, biography, social profiles, notification settings, or other identity.

approvalRequired.label: List Mention alert structure
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty-five alert IDs, query types, and index versions for the exact account without names, keywords, descriptions, shares, users, content, or statistics.

blocked.label: Access identity or alert configuration
blocked.description: Names, emails, avatars, biographies, social profiles, notification settings, alert names, keywords, queries, descriptions, shares, users, roles, permissions, sources, countries, languages, and configuration are blocked.

blocked.label: Access Mention Content, authors, or analytics
blocked.description: Mentions, snippets, titles, descriptions, URLs, media, authors, influence, metadata, tasks, logs, tags, folders, statistics, charts, dashboards, and reports remain blocked.

blocked.label: Write, publish, or administer Mention
blocked.description: Creating or changing alerts, mentions, tasks, tags, folders, posts, replies, social accounts, users, groups, clients, apps, tokens, subscriptions, or administration remains blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw API, streams, or bulk access
blocked.description: Arbitrary paths, methods, queries, bodies, stream hosts, cursors, pagination, polling, bulk operations, exports, browser sessions, and undocumented endpoints remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Both bounded reads require approval; identity, alert configuration, Mention Content, authors, analytics, streams, writes, raw APIs, pagination, bulk, and export remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same two bounded reads run directly; exact account binding, fixed GET routes, redaction, response caps, audits, API-version pinning, and provider rate responses remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives two bounded Mention reads with exact account binding and identity/content redaction.
Hermes receives the same two bounded Mention reads with exact account binding and identity/content redaction.

providerSetup.blocker: Mention's own-account API flow requires the customer to create an app and use its full-account access token. Relay restricts that broad token to two fixed read-only routes.
providerSetup.nextAction: The customer creates a dedicated Mention app token, supplies one exact account ID, and completes a live read-only connection check.

evidence.supports: Mention documents Bearer authentication, app-issued full-account tokens for the customer's own account, the fixed api.mention.net endpoint, API version headers, and resource-specific rate limiting with HTTP 429.
Official reference documents GET /accounts/{account_id}; Relay returns only the bound ID, safe language code, and time zone.

Official reference documents GET /accounts/{account_id}/alerts, a limit parameter, cursor pagination, and sensitive alert/query/share fields; Relay pins limit 25 and returns only ID, query type, and index version.
Mention's terms restrict Mention Content to the supplied Services and describe account, API-token, connected-profile, and personal-data handling obligations.

securityNotes: The customer token and exact account ID are encrypted as secret references; the bearer token is sent only in an Authorization header to https://api.mention.net and never in URLs, prompts, logs, catalog records, or results.
Mention states that an own-account app token gives full account access; Relay therefore allowlists only GET /api/accounts/{boundAccountId} and GET /api/accounts/{boundAccountId}/alerts?limit=25.
Every request pins Accept-Version 1.19, rejects redirects, caps responses at 1 MB, and returns at most twenty-five alerts without following provider cursors.

Names, emails, avatars, social profiles, alert names, queries, keywords, descriptions, shares, users, Mention Content, authors, URLs, analytics, publishing, writes, streams, and administration are excluded.
Relay preserves provider HTTP 429 responses and does not invent a single local quota because Mention documents resource- and method-specific limits rather than one universal ceiling.
